text:
rachel: Observability found KMS-wrapped ciphertexts in ingest stdout from a recent deploy. only a few lines but we should treat as P1. snippet: 

rachel: ```
2025-10-05T02:11:08Z INFO ingest: write blob id=b-9f wrap_ct=CqP...
```

tomo: Which key/SA? any hostPath mounts?

rachel: Key: projects/redwood-prod/.../keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/ingest-wrap-v7. SA: partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com had encrypter role for onboarding window. No obvious hostPath in chart but partner values included a compat shim.

sec-bot: IAM ALERT: partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com called cloudkms.encrypt on ingest-wrap-v7 at 2025-10-05T02:11:09Z.

vaultd: Vault audit for namespace "ingest" shows writes during that window. retention currently 30d; recommend 120d for forensics.

sre-oncall: Proposed immediate steps:
- revoke encrypter grant for partner SA (tomo)
- create new wrap key ingest-wrap-rot1 and enable dual-wrap reads for 48h (tomo + rachel)
- export hitlist of blobs from storage logs -> gs://redwood-sec/incident-3790001234/hitlist.json (restricted)
- run batched rewrap (dry-run staging -> canary -> prod) and verify checksums (owner: tomo)
- add an OPA/Gatekeeper policy to block hostPath and /var/keystore mounts in ingest namespaces (infra)
- bump Vault audit retention for ingest to 120d and add alert: wrap_calls_by_sa > 3/min => page (vaultd)

tomo: I'll revoke the binding now and push a TF change to remove encrypter. sample TF removal: 

```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "rm_partner_encrypter" {
  crypto_key_id = var.ingest_key
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  member = "serviceAccount:partner-onboard@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```

rachel: Rewrap plan: generate hitlist -> dry-run rewrap in staging -> prod canary 100 -> ramp. Use dual-wrap fallback on read for 48h, then retire old key versions after 72h if no errors.

sec-bot: Ticket SEC-2350 created: "keystore scrub + rewrap + RBAC lock". Assignees: tomo, rachel. Priority: P1.

rachel: Starting staging dry-run now. Will post small status update after dry-run and then prod windows. Keep this thread for the post-run checklist (hitlist path, batches, rotated tokens, PR links).
